# Plugin.Maui.AiChat: complete reference

This file is for AI coding assistants. It describes the whole public API of Plugin.Maui.AiChat 0.1, its behavior, and
the mistakes to avoid. Everything not listed here does not exist.

## Setup

- Package: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.AiChat`. Needs .NET 10 and .NET MAUI 10 (`net10.0-android`, `-ios`,
  `-maccatalyst`, `-windows10.0.19041.0`). Minimum Android 5.0, iOS 15, Mac Catalyst 15, Windows 10 1809.
- No registration: there is no `UseAiChat()`; the views are made of standard MAUI controls.
- Namespace: `Plugin.Maui.AiChat` (C#), `xmlns:chat="clr-namespace:Plugin.Maui.AiChat;assembly=Plugin.Maui.AiChat"`
  (XAML).
- Dependencies: Microsoft.Maui.Controls ≥ 10.0.0, Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Abstractions ≥ 10.11.0, Markdig. A chat client
  comes from another package. Tools need `Microsoft.Extensions.AI` for `UseFunctionInvocation()`.
  - OpenAI, `Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI`: `new OpenAIClient(key).GetChatClient(model).AsIChatClient()`. Any
    OpenAI-compatible API (Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, LM Studio) uses the same client with
    `new OpenAIClientOptions { Endpoint = uri }` and `new ApiKeyCredential(key)`.
  - Claude, `Anthropic`: `new AnthropicClient { ApiKey = key }.AsIChatClient(model)`.
  - Gemini, `Google.GenAI`: `new Client(apiKey: key).AsIChatClient(model)`.
  - Ollama, `OllamaSharp`: `new OllamaApiClient(uri, model)`.
  - Apple Intelligence on the device, `Microsoft.Maui.Essentials.AI` (preview): `new AppleIntelligenceChatClient()`, iOS
    and Mac Catalyst 26+ only; check `OperatingSystem.IsIOSVersionAtLeast(26)` and fall back to another client.

## Minimal chat

```csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using Plugin.Maui.AiChat;

public sealed class ChatViewModel(IChatClient client)
{
    public AiChatSession Chat { get; } = new(client)
    {
        Options = new ChatOptions { Instructions = "You are a helpful assistant." },
    };
}
```

```xml
<chat:AiChatView Session="{Binding Chat}" />
```

## AiChatSession (sealed, INotifyPropertyChanged)

The conversation, without UI. Create it on the UI thread and keep it in the view model (singleton or long-lived), so it
outlives the page.

| Member | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `AiChatSession(IChatClient chatClient)` | Throws `ArgumentNullException` for null. Captures the current thread's dispatcher. |
| `IChatClient ChatClient { get; }` | The client. To change the model or provider, create a new session and `Load` the old `Messages` into it. |
| `ChatOptions? Options { get; set; }` | Sent with every request. `Instructions` is the system prompt; `Tools` the tools; `ModelId`, `Temperature` and so on. Default `null`. |
| `IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage> Messages { get; }` | The history, oldest first: user messages, answers, tool calls, results and approvals. Read-only; change it only with `Load` and `Clear`. |
| `bool IsBusy { get; }` | True while an answer streams. Raises `PropertyChanged`. |
| `Task SendAsync(string text, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)` | Adds the user message, streams the answer, returns when it ends. Throws `ArgumentException` for null, empty or white-space text and `InvalidOperationException` while `IsBusy` (synchronously). Does NOT throw when the client fails: the chat shows the error with Retry and `ResponseCompleted` reports it. The token stops the answer like `Stop()`, without throwing. Called off the UI thread, it continues on the UI thread. Rejects approval requests that are still waiting. |
| `void Stop()` | Stops the answer in progress; what arrived stays in `Messages`. No-op when idle. |
| `void Clear()` | Stops the answer and empties the conversation (and forgets a `ConversationId`). `ResponseCompleted` is not raised for the cut-off answer. |
| `void Load(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages)` | Replaces the conversation. Throws `ArgumentNullException` for null and `ArgumentException` when an item is null. Accepts `session.Messages` itself. Waiting approval requests in the loaded messages can be answered. |
| `event EventHandler<AiChatResponseEventArgs>? ResponseCompleted` | After every answer, once `Messages` holds it: the place to save. |
| `event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged` | For `IsBusy`. |

`AiChatResponseEventArgs` (sealed, EventArgs): `ChatResponse Response` (combined from the updates that arrived; `Usage`
when the client reported it), `AiChatResponseStatus Status`, `Exception? Exception` (set when `Failed`).

`AiChatResponseStatus`: `Completed`, `Stopped`, `Failed`.

Behavior rules:
- After `Stopped` or `Failed`, tool calls without a result and approval requests are dropped from `Messages`, so the next
  request is valid; the text that arrived stays.
- Retry (the button on a failed answer) removes what the failed answer added and runs the same request again. There is
  no public `Retry` method.
- When a response carries `ConversationId` (a stateful service such as the OpenAI Responses API), later requests send
  only the messages after it, with the id in a copy of `Options`; `Options` itself is not changed.
- There is no `SendAsync(ChatMessage)`, no attachments, no regenerate, no edit of a sent message, and no streaming
  callback per token. Read the answer from `ResponseCompleted.Response` or `Messages`.

## Tools and approval

```csharp
IChatClient client = innerClient.AsBuilder().UseFunctionInvocation().Build();
var chat = new AiChatSession(client)
{
    Options = new ChatOptions
    {
        Tools =
        [
            AIFunctionFactory.Create(() => DateTimeOffset.Now, "get_time", "Gets the local time."),
            new ApprovalRequiredAIFunction(AIFunctionFactory.Create((string path) => File.Exists(path), "file_exists", "Checks a file.")),
        ],
    },
};
```

- Without `UseFunctionInvocation()` no tool runs: the model's calls only show as cards and end up Canceled.
- Each call is a card: name (function name, MCP tool name, or the hosted tool's kind such as `WebSearch`), arguments
  (`name: value`, JSON as sent), and a status: Needs your approval, Running…, Done, Failed (the function threw),
  Rejected, Canceled (the answer ended before the call finished).
- An `ApprovalRequiredAIFunction` call shows Approve and Reject. The answer continues when every request of that response
  has an answer. Reject sends a rejection; the function does not run. Sending a new message rejects waiting requests.
  If one call of a response needs approval, `FunctionInvokingChatClient` asks for all calls of that response.
- There is no API to approve from code, no auto-approve list, and no callback before a tool runs; use
  `FunctionInvokingChatClient` features for that.

## Saving and restoring

```csharp
var typeInfo = AIJsonUtilities.DefaultOptions.GetTypeInfo(typeof(IList<ChatMessage>));
chat.ResponseCompleted += (_, _) => File.WriteAllText(path, JsonSerializer.Serialize(chat.Messages.ToList(), typeInfo));
chat.Load((IList<ChatMessage>)JsonSerializer.Deserialize(File.ReadAllText(path), typeInfo)!);
```

Use the `IList<ChatMessage>` type info: `List<ChatMessage>` has none in `AIJsonUtilities.DefaultOptions` without
reflection (trimmed or AOT apps).

## AiChatView (ContentView)

| Bindable property | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Session` | `AiChatSession?` | `null` | Without a session the message field's button is disabled. |
| `Placeholder` | `string` | `"Message"` | Hint of the message field. |
| `AccentColor` | `Color` | `#512BD4` | User bubbles, Send/Stop, Approve. White text goes on it. |
| `EmptyView` | `View?` | `null` | Shown while the conversation is empty. Give it its own `BindingContext` (for example `{Binding Source={x:Reference Chat}, Path=BindingContext}`) for commands. |

- Rows: user message (bubble), answer (Markdown with Copy once complete), reasoning (tap to open), tool card, error (with
  Retry for the latest failure).
- The message field is an `Editor` that grows to 140; the button sends, or stops while busy. Enter does not send.
- The view follows the end of a streaming answer and stops when the user scrolls up; scrolling back down or sending
  follows again.
- Keyboard: on load it adds `SafeAreaRegions.SoftInput` to the bottom safe area of its `ContentPage`, unless the app set
  the page's `SafeAreaEdges`; on Android it also makes the window resize instead of pan while it is loaded.
- Light and dark themes follow the app theme. Text colors, surfaces and fonts are not configurable beyond `AccentColor`
  in 0.1. The app's implicit `Button` and `Editor` styles reach the parts.
- Automation ids: `AiChatList`, `AiChatMessageField`, `AiChatSendButton`, `AiChatUserMessage`, `AiChatAnswer`,
  `AiChatCopyAnswer`, `AiChatCopyCode`, `AiChatReasoning`, `AiChatToolStatus`, `AiChatApprove`, `AiChatReject`,
  `AiChatError`, `AiChatRetry`.
- Not available in 0.1: custom row templates, localization of the view's texts, avatars, timestamps, suggestions chips
  (use `EmptyView`), attachments, voice, Enter to send.

## MarkdownView (ContentView)

| Bindable property | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Text` | `string?` | `null` | The Markdown. |
| `IsStreaming` | `bool` | `false` | True while `Text` grows: unfinished `**`, `*`, `_`, `__`, `~~`, backticks and `[text](url` render as closed; renders are paced at most every 80 ms. Set it to false when the text is complete. |
| `TextColor` | `Color?` | `null` | `null` follows the theme. |
| `LinkColor` | `Color?` | `null` | `null`: violet, lighter in dark theme. |
| `FontSize` | `double` | `16` | Positive and finite; other values are ignored. Headings 1.5/1.3/1.15×, code 0.875×. |

- Supports: paragraphs, headings 1–6, bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, links and autolinks, fenced and indented
  code (language label and Copy; long lines wrap), bullet, ordered and task lists (nested), quotes, pipe tables (columns
  share the width, alignment honored), thematic breaks.
- A single newline is a line break (as in chat apps).
- Links open in the system browser only for `http`, `https` and `mailto`. Images are not loaded (alt text shows). HTML
  shows as text. No math, no syntax highlighting, no footnotes, no text selection.
- Renders on the dispatcher, not synchronously: after setting `Text`, the views appear on the next dispatch.

## Mistakes to avoid

- Creating the session in the page's code-behind on every appearance: the conversation is lost on navigation. Keep it
  in a long-lived view model.
- Wrapping `SendAsync` in try/catch for client errors: they never surface there; use `ResponseCompleted`.
- Calling `SendAsync` while `IsBusy`: it throws. Check `IsBusy` or call `Stop()` first.
- Expecting tools to run without `UseFunctionInvocation()`.
- Serializing `Messages` with `JsonSerializer.Serialize(chat.Messages)` without `AIJsonUtilities.DefaultOptions`: content
  types lose their `$type` and do not round-trip.
- Shipping an API key in the app. Call the model through your own server for production.
- Inventing APIs: there is no `UseAiChat()`, `AiChatView.Messages`, `AiChatView.SendCommand`, `ItemTemplate`,
  `UserBubbleColor`, `Retry()`, `Regenerate()`, `OnToken` or `LinkTapped`.
